source_document.body:
Over the past few years, LEGO has quietly added an impressive array of plug-powered machines to its block-based lineup, from hybrid racers to battery-powered excavators and garbage trucks. We’ve rounded them up here.
In putting this list together, I thought it best to group the kits by LEGO theme, which also serves as a rough guide to building difficulty. In other words: the further down the page you go, the bigger, badder, and more involved the builds will tend to get – and by the time you get to the app-controlled Caterpillar DX-11 electric drive dozer and Volvo EC500 Hybrid excavator kits, you’ll be looking at some seriously impressive (and seriously expensive) block-based builds.
Along the way, you might also find a number of electric cars, trucks, and equipment options that we’ve covered in these pages. I’ve included links to those posts as well, in order to provide plenty of some real-world context and give you more to explore once you’ve finished building.
Clicking on the name of the EV (example: Lotus Evija ) will open up an Electrek article about the vehicle, while clicking on the number ( 76907 ) will take you to a link for the kit, itself. Enjoy!

LEGO Technic | Heavy Equipment
Volvo EC500 Hybrid excavator; by LEGO.
Caterpillar DX-11 electric drive dozer 42131
Mack LR Electric garbage truck 42167
Volvo EC500 Hybrid electric excavator 42215
Volvo FMX truck & EC230 Electric excavator 42175
Volvo L120 Electric wheel loader 42209
Volvo ZEUS Autonomous concept wheel loader 42081
From what I can tell, that’s a pretty comprehensive list of the current available LEGO sets – but there’s way more EV love where that came from in the LEGO community forums, from unofficial Tesla showrooms to this tiny GMC Hummer EV concept. If you’re a fan of LEGO and just about anything else, take some time to explore the Product Ideas page, then let us know what you think of this list in the comments.
Images via LEGO; original content.
